title: Sulphur Sports
description: Adds Sulphur Cube renames to turn them into various sports equipment!
body:
With the new 26.2 update comes a whole plethora of new sports and minigames to play in your minecraft world!

With this resource pack, you can simply rename a Sulphur Cube to a whole host of sports equipments to amplify you and your friends games!

Current equipment:
Football, Golf Ball, Tennis Ball, Cue Ball, Spots, Stripes, 8 Ball

More being added soon!

**ETF and EMF Required**
